result_text:
The change is in `exportJson` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. The `reports` module compiles. I did not run any tests, and I did not try a renamed-aspect run.

`all_files.zip` no longer uses five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` literals. The five scope aspects are now collected in the same order as before (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other). For each one, the entry name comes from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same helper that writes the loose files. That name is used both to read the text file and as the zip entry name.

- **Default config:** the entry names are unchanged.
- **Renamed aspect:** the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`, so the read no longer fails. The failed read was what skipped `git-history.zip` as well.
